canonical_name: Networks Not Protected from Unauthorized Access
description: Networks and environments are not protected from unauthorized logical access.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for missing network segmentation, inadequate firewall rules, lack of network access controls, absence of intrusion prevention systems, weak authentication for network resources, and insufficient protection against unauthorized network access.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
